sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: BRET assay in HEK293 cells measuring β-arrestin1 and β-arrestin2 recruitment upon CXCL13 stimulation; receptor is functional and surface-displayed with the HA tag intact.
sites.rationale: CXCR5 has no signal peptide; the extracellular N-terminus (residues 1–51) is the only extracellular terminus available for a prepend tag. Python confirms residue 1 = M and TM1 begins at residue 52, giving 51 extracellular residues before the first TM helix—ample space for a short epitope tag. The HA-CXCR5-Rluc8 construct in L2 demonstrates both surface display and preserved β-arrestin signalling, making this the highest-confidence site. Multiple independent clips (L3, L4, L5, L6, L7 for FLAG/HA; L8 for SNAP-tag) corroborate the same N-terminal prepend junction. HA-CXCR5-Rluc8 full-length receptor expressed in HEK293 cells; HA tag placed at the extracellular N-terminus (residues 1–51, upstream of TM1 at residue 52), Rluc8 at the intracellular C-terminus. No signal peptide in CXCR5 (UniProt P32302), so the N-terminus is directly extracellular from M1. No specific junction residue is named in the clip; position is derived from the sole extracellular terminus.

sources.claim: (B–C). β -arrestin1/2 recruitment to CXCR5 was measured by BRET in HEK293 cells (B) or β -arrestin1/2 double knockout HEK293 cells (DKO) (C) expressing HA-CXCR5-Rluc8 and β -arrestin1-GFP 10 or β -arrestin2-GFP 10 .

literature_notes: All eight ledger lines converge on a single extracellular junction: the N-terminal prepend (insert_after_residue=0) of full-length membrane-anchored CXCR5. L2 is chosen as the primary supporting clip because it provides the strongest functional evidence (BRET β-arrestin assay). L3, L4, L5, L6, and L7 corroborate FLAG- and HA-tagged constructs at the same position but add no new junction. L8 (SNAP-tag fused to the N-terminal domain of CXCR5 in HEK293 cells, CHX-chase assay) independently supports the same N-terminal prepend with a structurally larger tag, further validating tolerance at this site. No ledger line names a specific residue for any N-terminal tag, so all are topology_derived. No ledger line supports an internal extracellular loop insertion (ECL1, ECL2, ECL3) for CXCR5. The C-terminal Rluc8 fusion (L1, L2) is intracellular and is recorded in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: Rluc8 fused in-frame to the C-terminal cytoplasmic tail of full-length CXCR5 (residues 325–372 are intracellular per topology landmarks); used as BRET donor for β-arrestin recruitment assays, not a surface-accessible site.
